chapters.title: What ships, what is left, and how to roll back
chapters.prose:
The branch ships the outbox table, the sender loop, and the retry delay. Three findings are closed and one is open.

The open finding (F3) is a lost error text on a parked row. It does not block the merge, and a follow-up task can fix it.

Roll back

Revert the merge commit and run the down migration for the outbox table. Parked rows are lost when the table drops.
